programmes.d: A retarded young man becomes the ward of Festus. A young man named Billy arrives in Dodge to visit his best friend, Festus. When the teenager, who has no family and is retarded, attacks and injures a drover for tormenting a cat, he is arrested.
There is something familiar about Tom Cook's new bride.
Kitty saves the life of a fellow stagecoach traveler and becomes deeply involved in his personal life.
A businessman arouses suspicion when he seems to have more than a business interest in the gold shipments of a stagecoach line.
An Indian girl defies the law of her people by asking white men to intervene when her tribe's leaders sentence her father to die.
An old buffalo hunter swears revenge on the skinner that left him to die.
A discouraged dirt farmer decides to leave his farm and try to become a man like Marshal Matt Dillon.
Festus Haggen’s hillbilly nephew, Eliab, comes to Dodge City to settle a score with Festus.
An irresponsible farmer walks out on his wile and family to carry on a romance with a young widow.
A half-breed Indian policeman, trailing three renegades, visits his white mother, but she refuses to acknowledge him as her son.
A bitter old man tells fibs about Indians preparing to strike Dodge.
The remaining survivors of two feuding Ozark families face each other in Dodge.
Louie Pheeters, the town barfly, witnesses a murder and tells the killer about it, thereby becoming the target of a deadly plot.
An embittered ranch woman holds Matt Dillon and Kitty prisoner while plotting Matt's execution to avenge her husband's hanging.
A vicious gunman, unable to collect a $1000 bounty, blames Matt Dillon for this loss and sets up an ambush on him.
Doc Adams saves a 12-year-old boy from hunger and exposure but cannot cure his desire for revenge.
A saloon girl does not want her ex-fiancé to know about her job.
A drover asks Matt and Chester to help him protect his boss' herd from a renegade raid.

Cameron Mitchell guest starts as Chauncey Demon, once a highly respected sheriff who has let himself degenerate into a saloon bum, and whose old friend Matt Dillon won't accept his condition as final.
A strong-willed daughter marries against the wishes of her father, who has dominated her all of her life.
Matt has trouble with a couple of troublesome mule skinners.

The residents of Dodge City are stunned when Matt Dillon feels he can no longer keep law and order and turns in his marshal's badge.
Marshal Dillon has a long, hard ride back to Dodge City with a prisoner whose gang pursues them doggedly.
A one-time marshal saves Matt Dillon's life and agrees to fill in for Matt when the lawman's wounds confine him to bed.
Quint Asper becomes the unwilling object of a girl’s affections when her harried parents travel through Dodge City.
An elderly ex-gunfighter demands to be buried in a cemetery next to his wife, but after his death the bitter townspeople oppose Matt and the law and try to prevent it.
A country bumpkin forsakes farming to seek his fortune in the city and tries his hand as a promoter of prizefights.
Marshal Dillon and Doc Adams are troubled by a meddlesome woman as they escort an escaped convict on a train trip to Dodge.
